content.title: Repetition: Let the Program Do the Same Work Again
content.hook: Repetition is another basic programming idea. Instead of writing the same instruction many times, a loop describes a repeated job.
content.context: Repetition is another basic programming idea. Instead of writing the same instruction many times, a loop describes a repeated job.
goals: Use loops to repeat work and reason about loop start, condition, and change.

content.title: for loop
Observe the values
content.text:
The body sees these values in order:

`0 → 1 → 2 → 3`

After `3`, the next value would be `4`, and `4 < 4` is false, so the loop stops.

content.question: What three ideas should you inspect first when a loop behaves strangely?

feedback.correct: Correct answer: A. Start value, condition, and change.

content.title: Forge takeaway & Lesson completion
takeaways: **Mental model:** A loop needs a path toward stopping.
**Senior habit:** When a loop is wrong, trace one iteration at a time and ask what changes before the next check.
nextSteps: Complete the checkpoint and explain the mechanism in your own words. A wrong first prediction is expected; the mastery signal is whether you can explain the result and handle a changed case after feedback.
